title: Evidence bundle manifest
description: The bundle.json written last into a sealed evidence bundle, carrying the second of the two identities: bundle_digest, the sha256 of the checksums.txt bytes. Written by crates/benchctl/src/seal.rs after crates/benchctl/src/checksum.rs walks the bundle; checksums.txt and bundle.json are themselves excluded from the walk, which is what resolves the digest circularity. Documentation mirror of the BundleManifest serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/bundle.rs, which is the source of truth.

bundle_digest.description: sha256 of the exact checksums.txt bytes. Each checksums.txt line is <64 hex><SP><SP><relative path with '/' separators>, byte-order sorted, LF-terminated, with a trailing newline, so `shasum -a 256 -c checksums.txt` verifies a bundle unchanged.

file_count.description: Number of checksummed files, excluding checksums.txt and bundle.json.

total_bytes.description: Total size in bytes of the checksummed files.
